svg.aria-label: The notebook's code for letters to numbers, with handwritten notes. chars = sorted(list(set(text))): one of each different character, in order, the 65-letter vocabulary. stoi: letter to ID, a letter's place in that list, so g is 45. itos: ID back to letter, for turning the model's IDs into text. encode: each letter of the text becomes its ID, so goo becomes 45, 53, 53.
